DataShield.app bundles a private, unmodified-in-function copy of the kitty
terminal emulator (https://github.com/kovidgoyal/kitty), copyright
Kovid Goyal, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3 — see
LICENSE-kitty.txt next to this file. kitty runs as a separate process and
DataShield talks to it only through the terminal; DataShield itself is a
separate work under its own licence.

The complete corresponding source of the bundled kitty version is available at
https://github.com/kovidgoyal/kitty/releases (see Contents/Info.plist's
KittyVersion for the exact release).
